## Security Model / Modelo de Segurança

This repository contains **instruction files and a CLI tool**, not a web service. The security posture is about **code safety** and **data protection**, not server security.

## Data Handling / Tratamento de Dados

### What CodeDocs reads (input)
- Source code files (via grep/find — pattern matching, not full file reads)
- Git history (via git log/git shortlog)
- Package manager files (package.json, composer.json, etc.)
- Configuration files (web.config, appsettings.json, etc.)

### What CodeDocs writes (output)
- HTML files in local `codedocs-output/` directory
- No data is sent anywhere — all output is local files

### What CodeDocs NEVER does
- Never sends code to any API or cloud service
- Never stores data outside the project directory
- Never requires authentication or account creation
- Never collects usage metrics or telemetry
- Never accesses network resources

## Known Gaps / Lacunas Conhecidas

| Gap | Risk | Recommendation |
|-----|------|---------------|
| No tests | MEDIUM | Add smoke tests for scanner + renderer |
| No CI/CD | LOW | Add GitHub Actions for Python lint + test |
| No code signing | LOW | Add GPG signing to commits |
| Single contributor | HIGH | Bus factor = 1 on all modules |
| No SAST/DAST | LOW | Consider Semgrep for Python code |
